description: Record a private, local fact about the user's agent context: timezone (IANA name), locale (BCP-47), or location (free label). At least one field is required.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name, e.g. America/Los_Angeles or Asia/Tokyo

locale.description: BCP-47 locale tag, e.g. en-US or ja-JP

location.description: Free-text location label, e.g. Tokyo, Japan
